claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost — { kind: "action" } or { kind: "magic_action" }
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Abjure Foes costs the Magic action. ClassFeatureActivationCost only has 'free' and 'bonus_action'. A generic 'action' variant (or a precise 'magic_action' variant matching SRD 5.2.1 terminology) is required.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Magic action, you can expend one use of this class's Channel Divinity to overwhelm foes with awe.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect — save_gate_condition
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The core effect is a Wisdom saving throw that on failure applies the Frightened condition for a timed duration. ClassFeatureEffect only supports grant_extra_action and heal_hp. A save-gated condition application variant is required. v4 atoms save_gate and apply_condition both exist; the gap is the surface composition.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition for 1 minute or until it takes any damage.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Condition — "frightened"
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Condition is currently a closed literal type containing only 'prone'. Abjure Foes applies the Frightened condition.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: ...or have the Frightened condition for 1 minute...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: TargetSelection — ability_modifier_count
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Target count equals the caster's Charisma modifier (minimum 1). Neither existing TargetSelection mode (one, choose_up_to with SlotScaling) supports ability-score-derived counts.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: ...you can target a number of creatures equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one creature) that you can see within 60 feet of yourself.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ConditionExpiry — { kind: "until_takes_damage" }
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Frightened condition ends when the target takes any damage. No existing expiry variant models 'until takes damage'. This is a common SRD pattern (many fear/charm effects use it) and warrants a surface-level expiry variant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: ...for 1 minute or until it takes any damage.
